svg.title: Ananya leads the inspection into the cord-filled Old Exchange.
svg.desc: Behind a brick doorway pressed by banyan roots, patch cords and amber lamps fill a working manual exchange. Ananya explains that it keeps the clinic's telephone alive during blackouts.
svg.text: Page 18, panel 1 · Wide interior establishing shot from the brick doorway

text.tspan: Ananya brings the inspectors into the manual
exchange that still carries modern service traffic.
